title: Chuyên đề thực tế - Kinh doanh Nông nghiệp

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand economic theories related to agricultural business.
Analyze real-world issues in agricultural business development.
Identify appropriate agricultural policies for specific business scenarios.
Apply problem-solving techniques to address agricultural business challenges.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate agricultural business situations.
Demonstrate active learning and research skills in agricultural business contexts.
Work effectively in teams to solve agricultural business problems.
Select and apply appropriate research methods for agricultural business studies.
Collect and process data relevant to agricultural business analysis.
Write clear and logical reports on agricultural business topics.
